hero.title: Udai Pratap College
hero.summary: Udai Pratap College is an autonomous affiliated college in Varanasi with agriculture among its established academic areas. Its 2026–27 prospectus lists undergraduate agriculture and selected postgraduate agriculture subjects. The audited ICAR record used here specifically covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.

overview.heading: Agriculture within an autonomous Varanasi college
paragraphs: Udai Pratap College is an autonomous institution in Varanasi affiliated to Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith. Its 2026–27 prospectus lists B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture alongside the wider college’s science, commerce and humanities courses. Agriculture is therefore part of a broader college academic setting.

The agriculture-farm section covers crop production and allied activities, including dairy, poultry, fishery and beekeeping. The prospectus also lists postgraduate subjects in agricultural economics, animal husbandry and dairy, soil science and horticulture. Applicants can compare the undergraduate practical experience and later subject options while checking the college’s entrance-examination conditions for their intended entry year.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: The 2026–27 prospectus identifies a four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture taught through a semester system. Exact current subject combinations and selection conditions should be checked in a readable prospectus copy.
programmes.eligibility: 2026–27 official prospectus: candidates who passed or are appearing in Intermediate/10+2 or equivalent with Agriculture or Science subjects may take the entrance examination. It states no entrance age limit and a maximum 5% other-state admission allocation on merit.
programmes.admission_route: College entrance examination and the applicable counselling procedure in the 2026–27 prospectus.

fees.note: A dated official fee schedule with tuition, compulsory charges and residential costs was not verified.

programmes.icar_scope_note: The audited ICAR row covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Udai Pratap College, Varanasi, U.P. for 2022-10-11 to 2027-10-10. Printed intake is retained in recognition as historical scope.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to UP College
admissions.intro: UP College’s 2026–27 prospectus allows agriculture or science Intermediate candidates, including those appearing in the qualifying examination, to enter its agriculture entrance process. Other-state applicants should check the stated allocation and counselling rules.
eligibility_points: Passed or appearing in Intermediate/10+2 or equivalent with Agriculture or Science subjects.
The 2026–27 prospectus states no age limit for the entrance examination and a maximum 5% other-state allocation on merit.

campus.heading: Crop production and allied farm activities
campus.intro: The official Agriculture Farm page provides separate sections for dairy, poultry, fishery, beekeeping, practical crop production and allied activities. These establish the farm’s published teaching areas, without proving current livestock numbers or student access hours.

facilities.description: The college publishes a dedicated farm section linked to practical crop production.

practical_learning: The official farm structure includes Practical Crop Production and allied activity sections.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: A current agriculture-specific scholarship schedule for UP College was not verified. Request the scheme name, funding authority, category rules, renewal conditions and net payable amount in writing before relying on a concession.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: The sources read did not provide a verified agriculture-specific placement-cell account or cohort outcome report for UP College. The presence of postgraduate courses and farm teaching should not be translated into an employment guarantee.

recognition.heading: Recognition and programme accreditation
recognition.text: The audited ICAR List II records Udai Pratap College, Varanasi, U.P. and the programme labels below from 2022-10-11 through 2027-10-10. This is the scope verified on 30 October 2026; it does not extend automatically to other qualifications or guarantee renewal.

faculty.intro: The official faculty-and-departments page names Prof.Raghwendra Pratap Singh as Agriculture Dean and identifies ten agricultural subject departments. It does not establish a full departmental teaching headcount.

faqs.question: Is UP College a university?
faqs.answer: It identifies as an autonomous college affiliated to Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith; this profile retains the college classification.

faqs.question: Which agriculture degree is listed?
faqs.answer: The official 2026–27 prospectus lists B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture and identifies it as a four-year semester-based programme.

faqs.question: What allied farm areas are published?
faqs.answer: The college’s Agriculture Farm page lists dairy, poultry, fishery, beekeeping and practical crop production.

faqs.question: Does the ICAR row cover all postgraduate courses?
faqs.answer: No. The audited row explicitly lists B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture. Postgraduate offerings in the prospectus are not automatically included in that accreditation statement.

faqs.question: Who may enter the agriculture entrance process?
faqs.answer: The 2026–27 prospectus names passed or appearing Intermediate/equivalent candidates with Agriculture or Science subjects. Its other-state and counselling conditions also apply.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at UP College?
Which named academic staff are listed for UP College?
faqs.answer: The official faculty-and-departments page names Prof.Raghwendra Pratap Singh as Agriculture Dean and identifies ten agricultural subject departments. It does not establish a full departmental teaching headcount. Prof. Raghwendra Pratap Singh — Dean, Faculty of Agriculture.

faqs.question: Which application documents are listed for UP College?
faqs.answer: Qualifying-examination academic certificates; Caste/community certificate where applicable; Income and domicile certificates where applicable; Aadhaar identification; Supporting documents for any claimed weightage; Originals of uploaded certificates at counselling; Character certificate, transfer certificate and anti-ragging affidavit for completing admission. Match these to the official requirements for your chosen programme and quota.

faqs.question: Which dated admission events are recorded for UP College?
faqs.answer: Historical 2026–27 entrance application opening — 2026-06-16 — 2026–27; Historical 2026–27 entrance application/payment deadline in brochure; check later amendments — 2026-06-25 — 2026–27. These describe the cited events and do not establish a continuing application window.

faqs.question: What establishment year is documented for UP College?
faqs.answer: Udai Pratap College is recorded as established in 1949.
